name: Rely On God
overview: The Scriptures call believers to place unwavering trust in God rather than in human strength or understanding, emphasizing that reliance on the LORD brings enduring strength and peace. God promises to fight on behalf of His people, inviting them to remain calm and confident in His power. Trusting in God is not only a source of protection but also a pathway to experiencing His plans for peace and hope, as He encourages His people to call on Him for revelation of His mighty works.
